releases.notes:
# Alpha v0.0.6
Finally, some good updates.

## Additions
### Plants
- Chomper: Can swallow a zombie whole, but needs to take a while to chew it first. Best used either disposably or behind a wall.
### Zombies
- Buckethead Zombie: Wears a bucket for substantially more protection than a cone, but otherwise functions like a more expensive conehead.
### Items
- Protective Pan: An item visually similar to Dave's Pan, but functions differently. Instead of lifting placement restrictions, it functions as an iron helmet, crafted with five iron ingots in a pan shape.
### Blocks
- Lawn Manager: The brain of the game. Its current functionality is:
	- If a zombie reaches a garden block, the right side will be powered.
	- If three target zombies are vanquished by plants, the left side will be powered.
	- If the block itself receives power or is interacted with, its state will be reset.
- Speaker: Plays a sound when powered. Comes in variants for plant victory and zombie victory.

## Changes
- The speed of zombies has been nerfed.
- Lawn blocks can now have their turf come in three different shades by being edited with the lawn gadget.
	- In addition, they've had some tweaks to their textures to have less of an emphasis on the grid lines.
- Many textures have had their colors altered, mostly for hue shading. If you don't like this change, feel free to enable the newly included "HLS - Old Palettes" resource pack.
- Some recipe items can now be substituted due to the existence of item tags.
- Seed packets now have their cost and recharge time in their tooltips.
- Seed packets' item models now only show their cost in the hotbar, where their models have more room to expand. It's hard to convey a whole character in such a small space. :P
- Zombie-plant collision has been reworked. Now, placing a plant will no longer push zombies out of the way. Instead, zombies will simply stop trying to approach when blocked by a plant. Don't worry, they're very fixated on eating them instead of progressing.
- Lawnmowers will no longer turn on corners. Instead, they will proceed off the path until poofing into an item after they have either been active for 0.5 seconds after leaving the path, or a total of 3 seconds, whichever comes last. The time will not refresh if it goes back onto the path, and it can be interrupted by a wall.
- Dave's Pan can now be found in the Operator Items tab.
	- This is also where you can find infinite versions of the currency bags.
- The functionality of Dave's Pan has become a component called `homelawnsecurity:ignored_placement_rules`, which can be customized with commands or even added to other items.
	- This has additionally resulted in the item letting you use seed packets wherever you want.
	- The tags are as follows (all booleans):
		- `check_when_held`: Set to `true` if creating a held item, `false` for a worn item.
		- `cost`: Makes everything free.
		- `cooldown`: Removes seed packet cooldowns.
		- `occupied`: Lets you place multiple plants on the same block.
		- `near_path`: Lets you place plants and zombies away from paths.
		- `team_side`: Lets you place plants and zombies on the other team's side.
		- `turf`: Lets you place path plants on unsodded lawn blocks.
- The mod now provides a link to the GitHub issue page when using something like Mod Menu.
- The mod now has support for the Sounds mod and will prioritize that mod's playback system over the one in this mod for seed packets and shovels.
- Shovels now display a "POW!!" particle effect when attacking plants and zombies. This overrides the vanilla damage indicator particles for this action, as it's always an instant kill.
- Lawnmowers now have destruction particles instead of the death animation.
- Lawn gadgets can now switch modes by punching the air instead of only a block.
- Wall-nuts now finally have proper degradation stages.
- Units now flash white when taking damage instead of briefly having a solid red overlay.

...

# Alpha v0.0.5.3 (1.21.11)
Mmm new game version :)

## Additions
### Debug
- Added a "new" debug renderer to show the pathfinding of path-bound entities. (Disclaimer: This is just an edit of an existing debug renderer that wasn't in the F3+F6 menu.)
## Changes
- Ported to 1.21.11.
- Made peas slower so they're less likely to phase through zombies.
- Fixed seed-placed entities being able to despawn and scam you of your seed packet.
- The shovel can no longer break blocks in creative mode. No, you still can't use it as a tool.
- Made all sounds mono. Counterintuitively, this makes them able to pan and taper off.
- Added decent support for Lolcat and Pirate Speak because it sounded fun.
- Fixed incorrect translation tags for two unused plant sound subtitles as well as added a translation for the Target Zombie entity.

# Alpha v0.0.5.2 (1.21.10)
Another port update, with less hesitation this time.

## Changes
- Ported to 1.21.10.
- Markers no longer glow.
  - This was due to their particle effect using currency entity code to render itself, but now there's a check for if the item displayed has the currency component applied to it.

## Known issues
- Markers no longer fade in and out.
  - This was actually a side effect of the marker particle having half opacity and it being summoned every tick, but an update split the particle rendering code into its own class and removed the alpha variable that was universal to all particles.
- Marker particles do not render when summoned with the `/particle` command.
  - At one point, I was considering just shipping the current version, where doing that crashed the game, but I actually decided to fix it to a certain degree.

releases.notes:
# Alpha v0.0.5 (1.21.5)
Even more changes and tweaks.

## Additions
### Items
- Turf: Use on an unsodded lawn block to make it a sodded lawn block. Use shears to take it off.
- Brain: Dropped by vanilla zombies. Feed it to a zombie to have it drop a duplicate seed packet. You can also do this with plants by using bone meal instead.

## Changes
- Path blocks have been combined with their path-less lawn blocks and now use block state properties to determine the path and intersection types. (Sorry for deleting your blocks!)
- There are now four types of paths, with any pair being able to intersect. The old path textures have been slightly modified as well.
- There are now ways to get most of the mod's items in survival mode!
  - This excludes markers, Dave's pan, and the currency items. Markers may get changes to fit survival later, but the other items listed are not intended for survival use.
  - Most of the items have recipes, but seed packets are obtained from the wandering trader, who sells three random plants and three random zombies for two emeralds each. Currently, that's all the plants and zombies the mod has, but when more are added, the trader will probably still only sell three kinds.
- Zombies can now only eat plants that are either in their way or not on a path.
- Removed the "Toggle Turf" function from the lawn gadget.
- The lawn gadget's ability to affect markers is now controlled by sneaking. This also works with the new turf item and shears.
- Plants will now properly only target zombies on their path, excluding paths of the same type that are not reachable.
- Plants and zombies will now stop targeting each other if their targeting conditions are no longer satisfied. Previously, they would only check their conditions when first finding a target.
- Lawn blocks will no longer drop with paths unless Silk Touch is used.
- Bags of currency will now properly show the amount inside them when selected on the hotbar.
- Lawn plants can now only be placed next to or on paths to make sure they can't snipe zombies without risk.
- Currency will now properly be spent again.
- The code for visual entity degradation (No, not that kind) has been turned into an interface for easier development. It also now has an NBT tag for if you ever relog while a zombie is half-dead.
- Plants and zombies will now drop their respective spawn items if they weren't placed in creative mode. This also applies to lawn mowers and target zombies.
- Zombies now take headless damage at an eighth of the previous rate. They still don't last very long, though.
- Zombies can no longer eat plants without their heads.
